primary: Frozen 10% review cap, directional claim that the difficulty-selected queue needs at least ceil(0.10 B) more checks. 17 primary-reference targets and the matched six-target subset on both references.
transfer: Repeat the unchanged rules at 5% and 20% review and with the two queue roles reversed. Report these separately.
audit: An eligible comparison has at least one record exclusive to the challenger. Audit min(round(0.10 B), number of exclusive records) using the original proportional exact test, or skip. Report paid checks, every skipped material case, and the exact detection probability on each replay.
rules: Fix all score signs and kernels before reading their comparisons. Borda uses mean inverted percentile. Log-rank uses negative log percentile scaled by log(2N). Top votes count the fraction of candidates ranking a record in their first B. Median uses inverted median percentile. Two-rank uses only the pair of competing ranks. Source margin compares each protocol's winner advantage in source hit counts. Overlap half audits if the challenger has at least B/2 exclusive records.
historical_controls: Use the same four dataset-level folds as the original paper. Compare the original multifeature rank model with a ridge on one rank-consensus feature and five equal-count bins of that feature. Historical labels are external setup supervision. Target audit is identical.
threshold_controls: For each nonconstant score learn the most selective threshold that retains all material cases in the inner held-out training replays. Exclude all outer held-out corpora from fitting and threshold selection, including when generating inner scores. Evaluate the resulting gate on the outer folds. No threshold is optimized using held-out outcomes.
criterion: For an unqualified win a rule must retain every material replay on the primary and matched second references and use fewer target checks than the simpler competitors that also retain every material replay. Keep all counterexamples. Compare lower-cost rules that lose cases separately.
